crossRefs.note: Then I called on Yahweh’s name: “Yahweh, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
In my distress, I cried to Yahweh. He answered me.
Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”
He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away…
Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…
Yahweh said, “I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their cry because of…
This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.
Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant, and for his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to…
In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came…
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
“When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

translations.web: In my distress, I called on Yahweh. Yes, I called to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry came into his ears.
translations.bsb: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.
translations.kjv: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.
translations.asv: In my distress I called upon Jehovah; Yea, I called unto my God: And he heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry came into his ears.
